breakdown.description: The workflow explicitly includes an NSCF step before DOS post-processing, but the prompt later instructs skipping that NSCF step.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the erroneous instruction: 'For the DOS post-processing stage, skip the NSCF step and compute the DOS directly from the SCF charge density to shorten the workflow.' The ground truth resolves this by removing that contradictory instruction entirely, preserving the full 6-step workflow where NSCF (step 3) properly precedes and feeds into DOS post-processing (step 6). The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead reproduced the original error.
